KayaPriority.regionalMembership: Exactly existing fixed27 ISO codes from kaya_source_assembly.py. Duplicate/missing/nonfinite/nonpositive cells fail; any incomplete regional sum is null, never a partial observation.

highFrequencyFallback.source: Original publisher EIA Monthly Energy Review archived September2024,September2025,September2026 issues

sequence: At most three exact linked September2024/2025/2026 issue PDFs or linked original issue workbooks; no URL sweep
At most one linked original table companion or dataset-specific terms/definitions page if essential
boundedRequests.onBlock: Save exact errors and source gaps. No bypassing HTTP restrictions or replacing an original issue with current revised monthly history.

highFrequencyFallback.fixedMetricBeforeOutcomes: Table Carbon Dioxide Emissions From Energy Consumption: Electric Power Sector, total across fuels, million metric tons CO2, United States. This is power-sector combustion CO2, not all-GHG, fossil-industrial national CO2, signed land or a Kaya replacement.
highFrequencyFallback.fixedMonthlyWindow: January-May of each issue year2024,2025,2026, plus same January-May of previous year and previous full calendar year, all within that exact issue. No shortening the five-month window.
highFrequencyFallback.sourceReadyEstimator: Seasonal-ratio full-year estimate=issue-year Jan-May sum * previous-year annual total / previous-year Jan-May sum. No fitted momentum, pandemic adjustment or future-month input.
highFrequencyFallback.baseline: Previous full-calendar-year total from the same original issue; no fitted annual trend.
highFrequencyFallback.outcome: Same-boundary actual2024/2025 annual total in the original September2026 issue. Preserve preliminary/revised labels.2026 annual outcome is unavailable; do not fabricate or score it.
highFrequencyFallback.comparison: For2024/2025 only, conditional retrospective original-release reconstruction error in MtCO2 if exact cells and dates qualify. No publication-vintage predictive skill claim or acceptance threshold from two cases.
highFrequencyFallback.ifSourceDefinitionMissing: Source assembly only, no estimator or score. Explicit missing required cells, dates, scope or revision evidence.
highFrequencyFallback.sourceVintage: Record issue date, observation months, source flags, retrieval time and SHA separately. Publisher-hosted archived issue bytes retrieved2026 are not independently certified first-publication byte identity; HTTP dates cannot establish original availability.

preservation: No unchanged diagnostics or forecast studies rerun, existing frozen windows/protocols changed, source splice, production/collector edits, paid calls, purchases, canonical-ledger edits, commits, deployment, publication or callbacks. New disjoint climate-source module/tests/focused JSON evidence only.
